description: Structural wire contract; native validation also checks indices, lengths and cross-field invariants.

allow_attribute.description: POINT FLOAT attribute in [0, 1] where seams are welcome; empty disables
allow_attribute.title: Welcome seams

avoid_attribute.description: POINT FLOAT attribute in [0, 1] where seams should be avoided; empty disables
avoid_attribute.title: Avoided seams

cavity_confidence.description: Recesses with less occlusion evidence are reported, not proposed (percent of the full evidence)
cavity_confidence.title: Cavity confidence %

deadline_s.description: Return a validated partial layout when time runs out; 0 is unlimited. An active solve finishes before the budget is checked again
deadline_s.title: Time budget (seconds)

enhanced_cavities.description: Rings and interior slits around occluded recesses
enhanced_cavities.title: Cavity rings

enhanced_regions.description: Re-partition over-budget islands along welcome seams (painted allow, creases), away from avoided ones
enhanced_regions.title: Preference-aware regions

enhanced_relief.description: Short slits at distortion hotspots of over-budget islands, before any broad split
enhanced_relief.title: Relief slits

enhanced_rings.description: Closed cuts around necks and creases, with their companion cuts
enhanced_rings.title: Constriction rings

enhanced_shells.description: Front/back splits of thin parts along their rims
enhanced_shells.title: Thin-shell rims

enhanced_sliding.description: Propose moving the slit of a tube-like part to its least exposed side along the rims; applied only when the validated result ranks better
enhanced_sliding.title: Slide tube slits

enhanced_spur_removal.description: Remove seam dead ends whose removal passes validation; necessary relief ends stay
enhanced_spur_removal.title: Remove unnecessary spurs

feature_angle.description: Edges sharper than this (degrees) become seams and are never merged away; 0 disables
feature_angle.title: Feature angle

forbidden_attribute.description: EDGE BOOLEAN attribute of edges that must never become seams; empty disables
forbidden_attribute.title: Forbidden seams

generate.description: Trace the quad layout and merge patches under the distortion budget. Off: only refine the existing seams and clean the contours
generate.title: Generate seams

hide_direction.description: Direction from the object toward the viewer, in object coordinates
hide_direction.title: Viewing direction

max_candidates_per_chart.description: Complete alternative layouts evaluated per island in one pass
max_candidates_per_chart.title: Candidates per island

max_displacement.description: Band for smoothed contours, in edge lengths
max_displacement.title: Max displacement

max_slide_distance.description: Object-space distance a slit end may move along a rim; 0 is unlimited
max_slide_distance.title: Max slide distance

max_solves_per_chart.description: Unwraps of proposals per island in one pass
max_solves_per_chart.title: Solves per island

min_fusion.description: A merge must remove at least this share of the smaller island's outline
min_fusion.title: Min fusion

min_island.description: Islands smaller than this share of the surface are merged into a neighbour under a relaxed budget
min_island.title: Absorb islands below %

min_island_faces.description: Absorb smaller islands into a validated neighbour, except whole components and boundaries protected by the artist
min_island_faces.title: Minimum island faces

policy.description: Native baseline, the default, or the enhanced proposal pass after it
policy.title: Seam policy

protect_existing.description: Seams already on the mesh are kept as locked cuts
protect_existing.title: Protect existing seams

prune_dominated.description: Refuse, before unwrapping, a proposal whose seams alone prove it cannot beat the kept layout
prune_dominated.title: Skip provably worse

reference_length.description: Object-space length unit of the physical distances; 0 uses the median edge length. Give the same value to compare different tessellations
reference_length.title: Reference length

refine_paths.description: Re-route open seam chains inside a corridor so they stop hopping between quad rows; anchors, junctions and locked seams are kept
refine_paths.title: Refine seam paths

required_attribute.description: EDGE BOOLEAN attribute of edges that must be seams; empty disables
required_attribute.title: Required seams

ring_confidence.description: Rings with less constriction or crease evidence are reported, not proposed (percent of the full evidence)
ring_confidence.title: Ring confidence %

scale_mode.description: How the enhanced features measure distances and sizes
scale_mode.title: Distances

shell_confidence.description: Thin parts with less front/back evidence are reported, not proposed (percent of the full evidence)
shell_confidence.title: Shell confidence %

symmetry_offset.description: Position of an axis mirror plane along its axis, in object coordinates
symmetry_offset.title: Plane offset

symmetry_on_conflict.description: What strict symmetry does when the mirror half breaks a lock, pin, anchor or painted constraint
symmetry_on_conflict.title: On a mirror conflict

symmetry_plane.description: Detected, or an object-axis plane at the offset
symmetry_plane.title: Mirror plane

target_enabled.description: Search up to five distortion budgets; an unreachable target is reported
target_enabled.title: Target island count
